Subject: SIG: follow-up on data retention & training Qs

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks for taking this on. We're in the middle of our vendor SIG and have a couple of specific asks we couldn't find clear answers for in the public docs:

1) Prompt/log retention: what does Redwood store by default for text prompts and completion logs (KV cache, prefix cache, raw request/response logs)? Are there retention windows and how are they configurable per-customer?

2) Training/derivative use: does Redwood use customer prompt/completion data to train models or improve downstream models? If so, what opt-out controls exist?

3) Evidence/artifacts: for the SIG spreadsheet we need a short written answer plus any artifact (diagram, audit log sample, or policy) we can attach.

Could you send your answers plus a draft SIG sheet? We have a deadline of next Thursday (7/15).

Appreciate it —
Jordan

Jordan —

Thanks for flagging; looping in Marcus (infra/ops) and Monica (CS/compliance) to confirm specifics. I've attached a first-pass of the SIG sheet (SIG_Answers_Redwood_v1.xlsx) and a simplified data flow PNG that shows where logs live. High-level answers below — I'll follow up with artifacts and timestamped evidence.

- Prompt/log retention: By default, request/response logs (used for troubleshooting, billing, and abuse detection) are retained for 30 days in the hosted product. For Dedicated/Private customers we support configurable retention policies up to 365 days via an admin setting (enterprise plan). Ephemeral caches (KV/prefix caches used by the runtime) are in-memory and not persisted to long-term storage by default; they are cleared on node restart and not used as an audit log.

- Training/derivative use: Redwood does not use customer prompts or completions to train or fine-tune public models unless a customer explicitly opts in (via an account-level setting and a contractual addendum). We may use aggregated, de-identified telemetry for product quality purposes (e.g., routing, latency tuning) but not model training on a per-customer basis.

- Evidence: attached are the draft SIG answers and a redwood-data-flow.png. We'll prepare a sample audit log export (anonymized) and a short paragraph describing retention controls.

I'll update once Marcus confirms the exact retention config names and Monica confirms contractual language.

Best,

Jasmine — quick clarifying note for the SIG sheet: the default 30-day retention applies to request/response logs for the hosted API (Redwood Hosted). For Dedicated we expose two knobs: "log_retention_days" (default 90 in our Dedicated bootstrap) and "audit_export_enabled" (false by default). For Private installs customers manage retention via their own storage; we provide config keys and scripts. I'll attach the infra snippet separately.

Also: clarify that KV/prefix caches are in-memory only and we do not persist user prompts to model training buckets.

-Marcus

Jordan — following up with refined answers and the artifacts you requested. See inline summary (short answers for the SIG column) plus links to artifacts. The attached spreadsheet has the full SIG cells filled.

Short answers (for the SIG sheet):
- Data retention (prompts/completions/logs): Hosted: default 30 days (configurable per-tenant up to 365 days on enterprise plans). Dedicated: default 90 days; admin can set log_retention_days. Private: customer-managed retention.

- Ephemeral caches: KV/prefix caches are in-memory only, not persisted to long-term storage, cleared on node restarts, and not included in audit exports.

- Training/derivative use: Redwood does not train models on customer prompt/completion data unless the customer explicitly opts in via account setting + contractual opt-in. We use aggregated, de-identified telemetry for product quality only and not for model training.

Artifacts provided:
- redwood-data-flow.png (visual: where request/response logs are written and which stores are controlled by customer vs Redwood)
- SIG_Answers_Redwood_v1.xlsx (filled SIG answers; see columns C-F for retention and training cells)
- Sample audit export (anonymized) — available on request; we do not attach raw customer logs in email.

Evidence references / links:
- Compliance pack (SOC2 summary + data retention policy): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cSIGDraft
- HubSpot deal (for procurement & contractual opt-in): https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3849

If you need a CSV sample of an audit export (anonymized) for the SIG evidence column, let me know and we can provide a scrubbed file via a secure transfer (SFT). We can also add a line in the contract that we will not use customer content for training unless explicitly agreed.
